owner: main session (PM); sources attested by the human product owner
governing_text: risk/1.1 Rulings 4.1-4.6; PD-0039 D2; PD-0040 OD-R2
rules: At most one entry per currency (two admitted series for one currency is an error: AMBIGUOUS_RISK_FREE_SERIES).
Only 'entries' are read by the engine. 'candidates' are never read; a candidate becomes an entry only after the owner attests its terms in SOURCES.json and confirms checklist items 1-8 of Ruling 4.6.

A currency with no entry gives Sharpe, Sortino, downside deviation and Jensen's alpha INSUFFICIENT_DATA, detail NO_RISK_FREE_SOURCE (Ruling 4.6). Never another currency's rate, never a constant, never 0.
Synthetic fixture series are never catalogued here (market-data Ruling 4.8).
A change to any field of an entry is a new catalog_id version.

entry_fields.date_semantics: which date a value is for, time of day, time zone
